headline: Sensex Rallies 400 Points as Nifty Tops 25,300 Led by FII Inflows and Lower Crude Prices

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Strong foreign institutional investor (FII) inflows boosted market confidence.
Lower crude oil prices helped support market sentiment.
Financial and banking stocks led early trading gains.
Positive Asian market cues contributed to the upward momentum.
whatHappening: Sensex surged over 400 points while Nifty 50 traded above 25,300.
ITC hiked Gold Flake Premium prices for the second time in 2026, boosting cigarette stocks.
Tata Power received a Q2 boost led by coal business performance.
Edelweiss Vice Chairman Venkatachalam Ramaswamy resigned and sought exit from the promoter category.
summary: Indian benchmark indices rose significantly today, with Sensex up 400 points and Nifty crossing 25,300. Market gains were driven by foreign fund inflows, lower crude oil prices, and strong buying in financial and auto stocks. Key individual movers included Cupid hitting a 52-week high and ITC rallying after cigarette price increases.
